title: The Hunter Dekkers precedent also points to no suspension for Brendan Sorsby

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: The Hunter Dekkers precedent also points to no suspension for Brendan Sorsby
sources.description: If/when the NFL explores whether a Terrelle Pryor-style suspension should be imposed on quarterback Brendan Sorsby after the supplemental draft, the Kayshon Boutte precedent points to no punishment.
